locations.label: Lab A water generator
locations.description: Collect a bucket at spawn or either laboratory and fill it at a colored pool. Power Lab A and Lab B by pouring water into their generators. Both temporary generators must run at the same time to open the bunker; refill one if it expires. Open the bunker, enter the left power room, dive down and knife the web blocking the turbine. Survive the underwater lockdown, then use the power switch. Break underwater spores to replenish air and surface whenever the room allows it. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Drained-chamber Pack-a-Punch
locations.description: Recover the three drainage parts: from the underwater power-room vent after its lockdown; from a hanging cocoon that you knife open in the purple-water room; and from the underwater tunnels beside Mule Kick. Search the branches of the tunnel carefully and use the air spores. Fit the three parts to the marked valves around the central flooded chamber to drain it and reach Pack-a-Punch. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.

locations.label: Zipline dock cog area
locations.description: The final cog sits on the small dock beneath the zipline. In solo, bash the zipline control with an electrified shield, ride it and melee to release directly over the dock. Traveling from the docks toward Lab A gives an early release point. In co-op, have a teammate electrify the control while the rider is over the dock to drop them. Collect the cog and use the path back. Area shown on an original schematic; use these landmark directions for the exact interaction.
